title: John Keel's non-government Men in Black

tellings.quote: often wrote about the types of men in black cases that Keel recounts where clearly they're not government agents.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher and researcher, talks on Jesse Michels's podcast about John Keel, a writer who collected strange encounters in the United States in the 1960s. Some of Keel's cases involve "Men in Black", mysterious visitors said to approach people after UFO sightings. Jorjani says that in the cases Keel recounts, these men are clearly not government agents, which would mean they are something other than human officials.
